claims.claim: A residential purchaser reported that an occupancy certificate was received after an earlier reported delay.
claims.limitations: This is one account of a property-specific outcome. It does not establish that the building was sanctioned, identify an official route, or establish a general processing time or issuance requirement.
claims.redaction: Project/developer, locality, author handle, dates more specific than month/year, and all other property-identifying details omitted.

claims.claim: A residential purchaser reported being told that an occupancy-certificate application had been made, while the certificate remained unissued several months later.
claims.limitations: The reported application and elapsed time are not independently verified. This cannot establish an official application route, deadline, service level, cause of delay, or who is responsible.
claims.redaction: Project/developer, locality, author handle, exact application and completion dates, and all other property-identifying details omitted.

claims.claim: A purchaser reported observing construction that they believed differed from the plan they had seen, and expressed concern that this could affect the availability of an occupancy certificate.
claims.limitations: The claimed mismatch, the plan's status, and any consequence for the certificate are unverified. This account cannot establish a deviation, official compliance rule, eligibility decision, or recovery route.
claims.redaction: Author handle, builder/landowner details, locality, property dimensions, unit configuration, floor description, and all other property-identifying details omitted.
